text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wh— The grand bath is out of order?!
We can only use—the showers?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No way...! I pushed myself extra hard looking forward to soaking in the tub, and now this...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I know! At times like this...
I should check out that spa I've had my eye on—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez! How on earth am I supposed
to go to sleep feeling like this tonight?!"
